name: 西游记2006年
group_note: 西游记2006 (AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded fork of the 西游记/ES II family). Requires a custom client-version handshake before the normal id/password flow: the very first line the server sends after the banner is a bare 'version ' prompt expecting the literal reply '2060' (the Tomud/Xiao Ao Jiang Hu client's auto-reply); any other first reply gets 'your client isn't Tomud...' and an immediate disconnect -- not a bug, just requires sending '2060' as the first line in any test client. WASM pass fixed 5 bugs: (1) two absolute-path angle-bracket #includes (d/obj/misc/jitan.h's </d/city/misc/banned.h>, d/obj/books-nonskill/book-qujing.lpc's </d/qujing/obstacle.h>, plus d/qujing/wudidong/monk1.lpc and u/vikee/dntg10/sky/tongmingdian.lpc) never resolve under this driver's include-directories search even though the target files exist -- switched to quoted includes. (2) The standard §6.6 convertd.lpc Greek/symbol-table stray-backslash typo ('a\",' for 'a",'), 45 occurrences, present in BOTH adm/daemons/convertd.lpc (the active CONVERT_D) and a dead unreferenced sibling copy at daemons/convertd.lpc (fixed both for tree consistency). (3) adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's tell_room() forwarded a bare unset 'exclude' varargs param straight into message()'s 4th arg (§7.12), crashing 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message()' on the very first 2-arg tell_room() call (a preloaded room's own heartbeat/sounding()) -- fixed with 'exclude || ({})'. (4) Two leftover raw-GBK-byte content files the original bulk GBK->UTF8 conversion pass missed (d/sea/npc/beast1.lpc, d/obj/quest/shuijingqiu.lpc) -- re-converted with iconv -c -f GB18030 -t UTF-8 (a few genuinely corrupted trailing bytes dropped via -c, cosmetic content loss only). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: version handshake (2060) -> new -> English id -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9 to accept defaults, y to confirm) -> enters world at 南城客栈 with full room description, look/score both clean, quit correctly gated behind the game's own new-account 1-hour-playtime-before-first-save rule (not a bug). Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)' on login. LPC formatter run across all 9264+ .lpc files (9118 written, 9 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted, 137 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the case-label-with-trailing-comment blind spot found several hits (combatd.lpc x3 copies, ftpd.lpc x3 copies) but diff-review confirmed the formatter preserved every following statement correctly. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin). RETROACTIVE follow-up: scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (new static scanner) flagged the active adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() still had the standard §8.1 i%2 parity gate + [i..<0] suffix slice (harmless here only because this family's is_chinese() checks just the first character, fixed to the standard per-codepoint form anyway) and 6 is_killing(me) call sites (§7.50) across daemon/class/*.lpc kungfu-skill files and lestat/old/roar.lpc -- fixed to is_killing(me->query("id")). 5 dead sibling copies of logind.lpc (www/relative/, u/canoe/, u/canoe/program/, u/vikee/, daemons/) still show the parity-gate pattern but are never loaded via LOGIN_D, left alone. httpd.lpc/ftpd.lpc/dns_master.lpc are absent from the active preload (dormant, only reachable via explicit wizard load) -- not gutted, flagged as a known latent risk. Re-verified clean post-fix.
